steps.text: Talk to Denulth in Burthorpe.
choices: How goes your fight with the trolls?
Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.text: Get some climbing boots or 12 coins, and prepare for fighting Dad and the Troll General. Both can be safe spotted by ranged/mage.
Follow the path west of Burthorpe, then go along the path going south.
Follow the path west of Burthorpe, then go along the path going south. Buy some climbing boots from Tenzing in his hut here.
choices: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

steps.text: Climb over the stile north of Tenzing.
Follow the path until you reach some rocks. Climb over them.
Follow the path from here east until you enter the arena.
Fight Dad until he gives up. You can safe spot him from the gate you entered through.
Leave the arena and continue through the cave to the north.
Enter the cave entrance.
Leave through cave's north exit.
Follow the path around Trollheim until you reach the Stronghold's entrance. Be wary of thrower trolls on the path, you'll want to use Protect from Ranged.
Enter the west rooms and kill any of the Troll Generals for a prison key.
Pick up the prison key.
Climb down the north staircase.
Enter the prison door.
Go back up the stairs.
Climb down the stairs to the prison.
Pickpocket or kill Twig for a cell key.
Pickpocket or kill Berry for a cell key.
Kill Twig for a cell key.
Kill Berry for a cell key.
Pickup the key.
Pickup the key.
Unlock Godric's cell.
Unlock Eadgar's cell.
Talk to Dunstan in north east Burthorpe to finish the quest.
